title: What Is FOMO? The Feeling That Makes Beginners Chase Crypto
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. FOMO is the fear of missing out, and it can push people to rush decisions. Sources: Investopedia, Fidelity. AI-generated voice. Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: EVERYONE IS TALKING ABOUT IT
scenes.sub: A COIN JUMPS IN A DAY
scenes.narration: A coin jumps twenty percent in a day. Social media is buzzing. You feel a rush to act. That feeling has a name.

scenes.head: IT IS CALLED FOMO
scenes.narration: F O M O means fear of missing out. It is the worry that everyone else is winning while you are standing still.

scenes.head: WHY IT HAPPENS
scenes.narration: It is fed by social media hype, fast price moves, and seeing other people celebrate their gains.

scenes.head: THE RISK
scenes.sub: HYPE PEAKS OFTEN FEEL LIKE THIS
scenes.narration: When excitement is very high, people may rush in without a plan. Prices that jumped quickly can also drop quickly.

scenes.head: HOW TO STAY CALM
scenes.narration: A simple habit helps. Pause before you act, do your own research, and decide on a plan before emotions take over.

scenes.head: REMEMBER
scenes.narration: Never risk money you need. Hype is not proof of value. And missing one move is okay, because there is always more to learn.
